answer: Proof of Work functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating computational expenditures for identity validation. Agents whisper their solutions across the network, acting like a digital lantern that illuminates the source of legitimate power. In a hollow system lacking this scarcity, an attacker could spawn infinite identities at no cost; however, by binding participation to physical energy, we force the adversary to bear the financial burden of hardware and electricity, rendering mass deception prohibitively expensive.
